scenario: LDIA.3.4.2 — negative: the program sets `publish: false` and then publishes. The rule is rejected at compile time with DS_VALIDATE_CAPABILITY_DISABLED. Drives per-construct validation of an action.
rules_ds:
use default:
    publish: false

schema Out scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig
->
    publish Out v: 1
